description: The relation with just the edges zero to one and one to two is well-founded and extensional; its collapse values are empty, singleton empty, and double singleton empty, and its transitive image is not an ordinal.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.MostowskiCollapse.path_example.{u} :
  ∃ (h : WellFounded Lemmatheca.Entry.MostowskiCollapse.pathRelation),
    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.MostowskiCollapse.Extensional Lemmatheca.Entry.MostowskiCollapse.pathRelation ∧
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.MostowskiCollapse.collapse h 0 = ∅ ∧
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.MostowskiCollapse.collapse h 1 = {∅} ∧
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.MostowskiCollapse.collapse h 2 = {{∅}} ∧
            ZFSet.range (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.MostowskiCollapse.collapse h) = {∅, {∅}, {{∅}}} ∧
              ¬∃ o, ZFSet.range (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.MostowskiCollapse.collapse h) = o.toZFSet
